content: Edhub360 is an AI-powered educational platform that helps students learn smarter. It offers features like AI Chat, Quizzes, Flashcards, Notes, Study Planner, Courses, and Screenshot Solve. The platform is available at app.edhub360.com.
The AI Chat feature allows students to have intelligent conversations with an AI tutor. Students can ask subject-related questions and get instant, detailed answers powered by Gemini AI.
Quiz Mode lets students practice topic-wise questions with instant feedback. Teachers can create custom quizzes. Students can track their scores and performance over time.
Flashcards help students memorize key concepts using active recall. Students can create, edit, and review flashcards by subject. The spaced repetition technique is used to improve retention.
The Courses feature provides structured learning paths. Students can enroll in courses, watch video content, and track their progress chapter by chapter.
Study Planner helps students organize their study schedule. Students can set daily goals, track study time, and monitor their weekly activity and subject mastery.
The Notes feature (also called Notebook) allows students to create and manage study notes. Notes support rich text editing and are organized by subject.
Screenshot Solve allows students to upload an image of a problem or question and get an AI-powered solution instantly. It supports math, science, and other subjects.

Edhub360 offers Free and Pro subscription plans. The Free plan gives access to basic features. The Pro Max plan unlocks all premium features including unlimited AI Chat, Study Planner, and Screenshot Solve. Subscriptions are managed via Stripe.
The Dashboard shows students their study streak, today's goal progress, total study time, badges earned, average quiz score, weekly activity chart, and subject mastery overview.
Students can sign up and log in to Edhub360 using their email and password or Google OAuth. Forgot password and reset password flows are supported.

How do I reset my password? Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the email instructions. How do I upgrade my plan? Go to Settings and click on Subscription. How do I cancel my subscription? Go to Settings, Subscription, and click Cancel. How do I contact support? Use the chat assistant on the platform.

Edhub360 is an AI-powered educational platform designed for personalized learning. Core features include AI Tutoring (Chat), interactive Quizzes, recursive Flashcards, dynamic Study Planners, structured Courses, and automated Screenshot Solving. The platform is accessible at app.edhub360.com.

### Quiz Mode Features:
- Topic-wise practice questions with instant feedback.
- Teachers can create and assign custom quizzes to classes.
- Performance tracking on the Dashboard (average scores and trends).

### Retake Policy:
Quizzes can be retaken an unlimited number of times. Each attempt is logged separately for progress tracking.

### Notebook Features:
- Rich text editing (bold, lists, headings, code blocks).
- Organized by subject and topic folders.
- Real-time sync across web and mobile.
- Sharing: Pro and Pro Max users can share notes via links or invitations. 
- What is the Notes feature?
Notes (also called Notebook) lets you create and manage study notes organized by subject. Supports rich text formatting.
- What formatting options are available?:
- Bold, italic, underline text
- Create numbered and bulleted lists
- Add headings and subheadings
- Insert images and links
- Use code blocks for technical subjects

### Can I sync notes across devices?
Yes, all notes are synced in real-time across web and mobile apps.

### How do I organize my notes?
Create folders by subject, then subfolders by topic. Notes can be tagged for easy searching.

### Can I share notes with classmates?
Pro and Pro Max users can share notes via link or invite specific classmates.

### What's the maximum note size?
There's no strict limit, but very large notes may take longer to load. We recommend keeping individual notes under 50 pages.

### Can I export my notes?
Yes, you can export individual notes or entire folders as:
- PDF
- Word document (.docx)
- Plain text

### Are my notes backed up?
Yes, all notes are automatically backed up daily. You can restore deleted notes within 30 days.

### Using Screenshot Solve:
Upload an image (JPG, PNG, or PDF) of a problem. The AI analyzes the text and diagrams to provide step-by-step solutions for math, physics, chemistry, and biology.

### Plan Limits:
- **Free**: 5 problems per day.
- **Pro**: 50 problems per day.
- **Pro Max**: Unlimited solutions.
- Why didn't Screenshot Solve recognize my image? The image may be: -Blurry or low quality - At an angle - Too small - In a non-supported format. Try re-uploading a clearer, straight-on photo.

### Subscription Tiers:
- **Free**: $0/month. Basic access.
- **Pro**: $9.99/month. Includes unlimited Chat and Study Planner.
- **Pro Max**: $19.99/month. Full premium access with unlimited storage.

### Payments & Management:
- Managed via Stripe. Major credit cards accepted.
- Pause: Yes, you can pause for up to 3 months. Go to Settings → Subscription → Pause Subscription. 
- Cancellations: Go to Settings > Subscription > Cancel. Access remains until the current period ends.
- Refunds: 7-day money-back guarantee for new users.
- Downgrade: Go to Settings → Subscription and select a lower tier. The change takes effect at the next billing cycle.
- Charges: You'll be charged on the same day each month (or year if annual). You'll receive an invoice email before each charge.

### Login Methods:
- Email and Password.
- Google, Microsoft, and Facebook OAuth (Social Login).

### Troubleshooting:
- **Password Reset**: Click 'Forgot Password' to receive a link valid for 24 hours. Check spam folders if not received.
- **Account Deletion**: Contact support@edhub360.com. Note that data cannot be recovered after deletion.

### Performance Tips:
If the app is slow, try clearing browser cache, checking internet connection, or restarting the device.

### Contacting Support:
- **Free Plan**: Response within 48-72 hours via email (support@edhub360.com).
- **Pro Plan**: 24-hour response time.
- **Pro Max**: Priority chat support (4-8 hours).
- Data Security: EdHub360 uses industry-standard encryption and security protocols to protect your personal information. See our Privacy Policy for detail

### What is AI Chat?
AI Chat provides an intelligent conversation interface with an AI tutor powered by Google Gemini. Students can ask subject-related questions and receive instant, detailed explanations.

### Usage Limits:
- **Free Plan**: 10 messages per day.
- **Pro Plan**: Unlimited AI Chat.
- **Pro Max Plan**: Unlimited AI Chat with priority response times.

### Scope:
The tutor assists with Mathematics, Science, History, Languages, Literature, and Computer Science.

### How do Flashcards work?
Edhub360 uses active recall and spaced repetition techniques to improve long-term retention. Students can organize cards by subject.
- Import/Export:
- Import sets from Quizlet and Anki in .csv format (Pro/Pro Max).
- Export decks as PDFs for offline study.
- What are flashcards used for?
Flashcards help you memorize key concepts using active recall. They work with spaced repetition to boost long-term retention.

### How do I create flashcards?
Go to Flashcards → Create. Enter the question on the front and answer on the back. Organize by subject.

### Can I import flashcards from other sources?
Yes, you can import flashcard sets from Quizlet and Anki in .csv format (Pro/Pro Max).

### How does spaced repetition work?
Spaced repetition shows harder cards more frequently and easier cards less often, optimizing your study time.

### Can I study offline?
Not currently, but you can download your flashcards as a PDF for offline reference.

### How many flashcards can I create?
- **Free plan**: Up to 100 flashcards.
- **Pro plan**: Unlimited flashcards.
- **Pro Max plan**: Unlimited flashcards + advanced categories.

### Can I share flashcards with classmates?
Pro and Pro Max users can generate a shareable link. Recipients can view but not edit.

### Can I study flashcards on mobile?
Yes, the mobile app supports full flashcard functionality including spaced repetition.

### What is the Study Planner?
The Study Planner helps you organize your study schedule, set daily goals, and track your progress.

### How do I set a study goal?
Go to Study Planner → Set Goal. Choose:
- Daily study duration (e.g., 2 hours)
- Subjects to focus on
- Topics or chapters to cover

### How do I track my progress?
The Dashboard shows:
- Study streak (consecutive days studied)
- Today's goal progress (% completed)
- Total study time logged
- Weekly activity chart
- Subject-wise mastery percentage

### Can I set recurring study goals?
Yes, you can set goals for specific days of the week. Goals automatically repeat unless you disable them.

### What happens when I reach my daily goal?
You'll see a success notification and earn badges/rewards.

### Can I adjust my goals mid-week?
Yes, go to Study Planner → Edit Goals anytime. Changes take effect immediately.

### How is study time calculated?
Study time is tracked when you:
- Use AI Chat
- Take Quizzes
- Review Flashcards
- Work on Notes
- Use Screenshot Solve

### Does the app track inactive time?
No, idle sessions (no activity for 10 minutes) are not counted toward study time.

### What are Courses?
Courses provide structured learning paths with video content, materials, and quizzes organized chapter by chapter.

### How do I enroll in a course?
Go to Courses → Browse and select a course. Click 'Enroll' (may require Pro plan for certain courses).

### Can I access course videos offline?
Not currently, but you can download course materials as PDFs.

### How do I track course progress?
The Course Dashboard shows:
- Modules completed
- Current chapter progress
- Overall completion percentage
- Certificate eligibility

### Are there course certificates?
Pro and Pro Max users who complete 100% of a course can download a certificate of completion.

### Can I take courses at my own pace?
Yes, there are no deadlines. You can pause and resume courses anytime.

### What if I want to retake a course?
You can retake any course. Your progress restarts, but your previous completion is saved in your history.

### Are new courses added regularly?
Yes, we add new courses monthly. Check 'What's New' in the Courses section.

### What information is shown on the Dashboard?
The Dashboard displays:
- Study streak
- Today's goal progress
- Total study time
- Badges earned
- Average quiz score
- Weekly activity chart
- Subject mastery overview
- Recent activity

### What is a study streak?
Your study streak counts consecutive days you've used EdHub360. The more days you study, the higher your streak!

### How do I earn badges?
Badges are earned by:
- Reaching daily goals
- Completing courses
- Achieving high quiz scores
- Consistent study habits
- Milestone achievements

### What are subject badges?
Subject badges show your mastery level in each subject:
- **Bronze**: 0-40% mastery
- **Silver**: 41-70% mastery
- **Gold**: 71-90% mastery
- **Platinum**: 91-100% mastery

### Can I reset my stats?
Go to Settings → Reset Progress. Note: This action cannot be undone.

### How is mastery calculated?
Subject mastery is based on:
- Quiz performance in that subject
- Course completion
- Time spent on that subject
- Consistency of study

### Can I view detailed analytics?
Pro and Pro Max users can access advanced analytics showing learning patterns, weak areas, and improvement recommendations.

### The app is running slowly. What can I do?
Try:
- Clearing your browser cache
- Restarting the app
- Checking your internet connection
- Updating to the latest app version
- Restarting your device

### I'm getting an error message. What should I do?
Note the error code and message. Take a screenshot and email support@edhub360.com with details.

### My changes aren't saving. How do I fix this?
- Check your internet connection
- Try saving again
- Clear cache and reload
- Log out and back in
- Contact support if the issue persists

### The app keeps crashing. How do I resolve this?
1. Update to the latest app version
2. Restart your device
3. Uninstall and reinstall the app
4. Check available storage space
5. Contact support@edhub360.com

### How long does customer support typically respond?
- **Free plan**: 48-72 hours
- **Pro plan**: 24 hours
- **Pro Max plan**: 4-8 hours (priority support)

### Can I contact support via chat?
Chat support is available for Pro and Pro Max users. Free users can email support@edhub360.com.

### What's the best way to contact EdHub360 support?
- **Email**: support@edhub360.com
- **In-app chat**: (Pro/Pro Max users)
- **Contact form**: edhub360.com/contact

### Is there a knowledge base or help center?
Yes, visit help.edhub360.com for FAQs, guides, and video tutorials.

### Is EdHub360 suitable for teachers?
Yes! Teachers can use EdHub360 to:
- Create custom quizzes
- Assign study materials
- Track student progress
- Create classes and manage students

### How do I create a classroom?
Go to Teacher Dashboard → Create Class. Name your class, add a description, and invite students using class codes or email.

### How do I assign assignments to students?
Go to your class → Assignments → Create. Select content type (quiz, flashcard set, course), set a deadline, and assign to students.

### Can I see student progress in real-time?
Yes, the Teacher Dashboard shows real-time analytics on:
- Student completion rates
- Quiz performance
- Study time
- Engagement metrics

### How do I invite students to my class?
Generate a class code students can use to join, or send direct email invitations.

### Can I customize content for my class?
Yes, you can create custom quizzes, notes, and study materials specific to your curriculum.

### What's included in the Teacher Plan?
Teacher plans include:
- Unlimited student assignments
- Full classroom analytics
- Custom content creation
- Priority support
- Certificate generation for students

### How much does a Teacher Plan cost?
Contact sales@edhub360.com for teacher/school pricing and discounts.

### Is my data secure on EdHub360?
Yes. We use:
- SSL/TLS encryption for data in transit
- AES-256 encryption for data at rest
- Regular security audits
- GDPR and COPPA compliance
- Secure password hashing

### What data does EdHub360 collect?
We collect:
- Account information (name, email, age)
- Learning data (quiz scores, study habits, progress)
- Device/browser information
- IP address for security

We do NOT sell your data to third parties.

### How do I access my personal data?
Go to Settings → Privacy → Download My Data. You can export all your information in standard formats.

### Can I request data deletion?
Yes, go to Settings → Account → Delete Account. All personal data and learning records will be permanently deleted within 30 days.

### Is EdHub360 GDPR compliant?
Yes, EdHub360 complies with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.

### Is EdHub360 safe for children (COPPA compliant)?
Yes, we comply with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA). Parents can request details on what data we collect for minors.

### Who can access my study data?
Only you can access your data. Teachers can only see assignment completion and quiz scores if they assigned the work.

### How often are backups taken?
We perform daily automatic backups. Data is replicated across multiple secure servers.

### What's your data retention policy?
We keep your data as long as your account is active. After deletion, we retain anonymized analytics for 90 days, then permanently delete.

### How do I suggest a feature?
Go to Settings → Send Feedback or email ideas@edhub360.com. We review all suggestions!

### How do I report a bug?
Report bugs via:
- In-app Feedback button (Settings → Report Bug)
- Email: bugs@edhub360.com
- Include steps to reproduce and screenshots

### Can I see which features are coming soon?
Yes, visit roadmap.edhub360.com to see upcoming features and vote on priorities.

### How are feature priorities decided?
We prioritize based on:
- User votes on the roadmap
- Frequency of feature requests
- User feedback and surveys
- Strategic alignment

### How long does it take for features to be released?
Timeframes vary. Small features: 2-4 weeks. Medium features: 1-3 months. Major features: 3+ months.

### Can I beta test new features?
Yes! Join our Beta Program at edhub360.com/beta to get early access to new features.

### How often are updates released?
We release minor updates weekly and major updates monthly.

### Where can I see what changed in each update?
Go to Settings → About → Release Notes to view the complete changelog.
